newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bond future closes near highs, volume thin.
newsitem.headline: French bond future closes near highs, volume thin.

text.p: 1557 GMT - French 10-yr bond future settles just off historic high but volume thin. PIBOR flat. Analysts unsure about durability of gains with market at such high levels. *Mar 10-yr future 131.46, up 0.18. Vol 47,065. High 131.50 *6.50 2006 OAT yield 5.45 pct vs 5.48. Bund spread -16 vs -15 *Ffr 3.3753 per mark vs 3.3740. Mar PIBOR unch at 96.71.
